## Question and context

Decide precise lifecycle transitions so controls, completion, and recovery produce one understandable outcome.

## Investigation

- Define states and pending Pause, Finish, Stop, and Resume behavior during preparation, baseline, candidate work, evaluation, and finalization.
- Resolve control/completion races, grace periods, remote-loss bounds, missing-instance behavior, compatibility failures, reservation release, and native-close failures.
- Decide behavior when no candidate or valid baseline exists and when hardware changes after pause. Preserve the agreed resumability and manual provider lifecycle.

## Deliverable

Record the lifecycle state/transition rules and recovery precedence in the decision comment. Add a larger transition document only if needed to make the rules usable.

Post a decision comment on this issue. Prefer that comment as the complete deliverable. State the decision, supporting evidence, relevant trade-offs, consequences, and remaining uncertainty. Create additional repository documentation only when the size or complexity makes a larger record necessary. If documentation is necessary, the decision comment must summarize the outcome and link to it.

## Completion criteria

- [ ] Walk through each control in every affected phase and state its resulting run, attempt, decision, and reservation state.
- [ ] Resolve examples involving simultaneous completion and Stop, lost contact during evaluation, and restart with a pending decision.
- [ ] State explicit close-failure and hardware-change behavior without inventing accepted models or confirmed remote stopping.

- [ ] Post the decision comment. If a larger supporting document is necessary, summarize it in the comment and link to the document.

issues.body:
## Purpose

Bound remote research after persistent loss of the local controller.

## Task and requirements

- Apply the chosen short reconnection grace period and stop further exploration and experiment launches after persistent loss.
- Let only the current committed experiment finish within execution bounds; preserve untested work if no experiment is executing.
- Persist results remotely and pause. Leave acceptance pending when it cannot be established and require explicit Resume after recovery.

## Behavior flow

```text
contact is lost
  allow the agreed short grace period
  if loss persists, stop exploration and new launches
  bound the current committed execution, if present
  preserve work and any pending result remotely
  pause until reconciliation and explicit Resume
```

## Deliverable

A remote safeguard that operates without receiving a final message from the local application.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Disconnect briefly and confirm the configured grace behavior does not fabricate an experiment failure.
- [ ] Lose the controller persistently and confirm no new experiment launches while current work follows its bounds.
- [ ] Repeat with no executing experiment and during unavailable acceptance; confirm untested work or pending results are preserved and the run pauses.
